question: EXP-03 showed real iTunes 12.13.11.1 accepting one playlist created by itlkit. Does that generalise to the other playlist operations itlkit refuses on this version - replacing a playlist's members, and deleting a playlist - or was creation the benign special case?

method.tool: research/g4/exp04/playlist_ops.py, which imports the EXP-03 bypass rather than reimplementing it
method.what_is_relaxed: only the version string presented to operations.require_simple_library, for the duration of the gate call
method.what_is_not_relaxed: identity and reference validation, header and trailer rules, section allowlist, empty-grandchild rules, store-index shape, global-metadata child codes
method.offline_control: the same round trip runs through the REAL gate on a supported 12.13.10.3 snapshot before anything is presented to the application

candidates.built_by: create_playlist, then replace_playlist_members to empty, then replace_playlist_members back to one track
candidates.expected_if_accepted: COM enumerates 8 playlists including exp04-itlkit-playlist with 1 track

candidates.built_by: the same three calls, then delete_playlist
candidates.expected_if_accepted: COM enumerates the usual 7 playlists and no exp04-itlkit-playlist, with the track still present

acceptance_requires_all_of: iTunes opens the intended file, not a rebuilt or fallback library
no damaged-file dialog and no new library file appears
the COM playlist set matches the candidate's stated expectation
the single track is still present
a normal COM Quit, not a kill
the same COM reading after restart 1 and restart 2
itlkit can still read the file iTunes leaves behind
does_not_count_as_acceptance: the expected state appearing only before the first Quit
failure_signals: the playlist set does not match the expectation
a difference between restart 1 and restart 2

predictions_recorded_in_advance.EXP-04a: likely accepted if EXP-03 generalises; member replacement rewrites the same structures creation writes
predictions_recorded_in_advance.EXP-04b: genuinely uncertain; deletion has to leave the surrounding indices consistent, and a stale reference would be exactly the kind of defect the application would reject

binding_limits: Acceptance does NOT widen itlkit's accepted-profile set; the gate stays.
Rejection of either candidate is reported as plainly as acceptance, and retracts nothing less than the corresponding EXP-03 generalisation.
The preserved baseline library is restored afterwards.
